PrecannedReply.name: Aknowledging a ticket
PrecannedReply.description: Predefined response to be used to inform the caller that their ticket has been acknowledged.
PrecannedReply.body:
Hello $this->caller_id_friendlyname$

 

Thank you for your enquiry. It has been recorded in our system under reference number ‘$this->ref$  $this->title$’.

Our support team will look into it and we will get back to you as soon as possible.


Kind regards,

The $this->team_id_friendlyname$ team

PrecannedReply.name: Ticket resolution
PrecannedReply.description: Predefined response to be used to inform the requester that their ticket has been resolved.
PrecannedReply.body:
Hello $this->caller_id_friendlyname$,

 

I am resolving ticket '$this->ref$  $this->title$', but you may add a comment within a week before it is automatically closed.

 

Kind regards,

$this->agent_id->friendlyname$
